name: mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3-LTWS β
status: PACKAGING REHEARSAL. Not a release candidate and not uploaded; whether and what to release is Ryō's decision under docs/v18/HF_RELEASE.md.

host.weights: not included: load the pinned upstream revision, unchanged

memory.text: canonical fact lines (engine package.canonical_facts), tokenized without special tokens
memory.encoding: the memory alone through the host's layers below the cut; its states enter before the question's at the cut and the host's remaining layers continue

prompt.instruction: Use the world facts to decide whether the ranking statement is true. If it is false, answer no; if it is true, answer yes. Output exactly one lowercase word: no or yes.
prompt.template: the tokenizer's native chat template, one user turn, generation prompt
prompt.source: V15 query-only rendering with the answer cue (scripts/v15_cue_contract.py)

training.schedule: constant 3e-4 to update 256, then linear decay: lr(step) = 3e-4 x (513 - step) / 257 for step > 256, reaching 1.2e-6 at update 512 (engine training.learning_rate_at)
